senses.gloss:
शुङ्ग शुङ्ग, अस्, m. (etymology doubtful),
the Indian fig-tree (= वट); the hog-plum (=
आम्रातक); the awn of corn; N. of a dynasty of
kings; (आ), f. the sheath or calyx of a young bud;
the waved-leaf fig; the awn of barley &c., a bristle.
—शुङ्गा-कर्मन्, अ, n. a form of the Saṃskāra or
rite called Puṃ-savana, (see under 2. पुंस्.)

शुङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a sheath or calyx; awned,
furnished with an awn; (ई), m. the Indian fig-tree
(= वट); the waved-leaf fig-tree (= प्लक्ष).
